verses.arabicText: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qad aflaḥa l-mu'minūn
verses.translation: Successful indeed are the believers

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَـٰشِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Alladhīna hum fī ṣalātihim khāshiʿūn
verses.translation: those who humble themselves in prayer

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna hum ʿani l-laghwi muʿ'riḍūn
verses.translation: those who avoid idle talk

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَـٰعِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna hum lilzzakati fāʿilūn
verses.translation: those who pay alms-tax

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūn
verses.translation: those who guard their chastity

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illā ʿalā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīn
verses.translation: except with their wives or those ˹bondwomen˺ in their possession, for then they are free from blame

verses.arabicText: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
verses.transliteration: Famani ib'taghā warāa dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-ʿādūn
verses.translation: but whoever seeks beyond that are the transgressors

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna hum li-amānātihim waʿahdihim rāʿūn
verses.translation: ˹the believers are also˺ those who are true to their trusts and covenants

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalawātihim yuḥāfiẓūn
verses.translation: and those who are ˹properly˺ observant of their prayers

verses.arabicText: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ulāika humu l-wārithūn
verses.translation: These are the ones who will be awarded

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Alladhīna yarithūna l-fir'dawsa hum fīhā khālidūn
verses.translation: Paradise as their own. They will be there forever

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن سُلَـٰلَةٍ مِّن طِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna min sulālatim-min ṭīn
verses.translation: And indeed, We created humankind from an extract of clay

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ نُطْفَةً فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Thumma jaʿalnāhu nuṭ'fatan fī qarārim-makīn
verses.translation: then placed each ˹human˺ as a sperm-drop in a secure place

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَـٰمًا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَـٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Thumma khalaqnā n-nuṭ'fata ʿalaqatan fakhalaqnā l-ʿalaqata muḍ'ghatan fakhalaqnā l-muḍ'ghata ʿiẓāman fakasawnā l-ʿiẓāma laḥman thumma anshanāhu khalqan ākhara fatabāraka l-lahu aḥsanu l-khāliqīn
verses.translation: then We developed the drop into a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then developed the clot into a lump ˹of flesh˺, then developed the lump into bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, then We brought it into being as a new creation. So Blessed is Allah, the Best of Creators

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
verses.transliteration: Thumma innakum baʿda dhālika lamayyitūn
verses.translation: After that you will surely die

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ
verses.transliteration: Thumma innakum yawma l-qiyāmati tub'ʿathūn
verses.translation: then on the Day of Judgment you will be resurrected

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَـٰفِلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad khalaqnā fawqakum sabʿa ṭarāiqa wamā kunnā ʿani l-khalqi ghāfilīn
verses.translation: And indeed, We created above you seven levels ˹of heaven˺. We are never unmindful of ˹Our˺ creation

verses.arabicText: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسْكَنَّـٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-anzalnā mina s-samāi māan biqadarin fa-askannāhu fī l-arḍi wa-innā ʿalā dhahābin bihi laqādirūn
verses.translation: We send down rain from the sky in perfect measure, causing it to soak into the earth. And We are surely able to take it away

verses.arabicText: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَـٰبٍ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-anshanā lakum bihi jannātim-min-nakhīliw-wa-aʿnābin lakum fīhā fawākihu kathīratuw-wamin'hā takulūn
verses.translation: With it We produce for you gardens of palm trees and grapevines, in which there are abundant fruits, and from which you may eat

verses.arabicText: وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِّلْـَٔاكِلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Washajaratan takhruju min ṭūri saynāa tanbutu bil-duh'ni waṣib'ghil-lil'ākilīn
verses.translation: as well as ˹olive˺ trees which grow at Mount Sinai, providing oil and a condiment to eat

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ لَعِبْرَةً ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-inna lakum fī l-anʿāmi laʿib'ratan-nus'qīkum mimmā fī buṭūnihā walakum fīhā manāfiʿu kathīratuw-wamin'hā takulūn
verses.translation: And there is certainly a lesson for you in cattle, from whose bellies We give you ˹milk˺ to drink, and in them are many other benefits for you, and from them you may eat

verses.arabicText: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waʿalayhā waʿalā l-ful'ki tuḥ'malūn
verses.translation: And you are carried upon ˹some of˺ them and upon ships

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi faqāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūn
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people. He declared, “O my people! Worship Allah ˹alone˺. You have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”

verses.arabicText: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Faqāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi mā hādhā illā basharum-mith'lukum yurīdu ay-yatafaḍḍala ʿalaykum walaw shāa l-lahu la-anzala malāikatam-mā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī ābāinā l-awalīn
verses.translation: But the disbelieving chiefs of his people said ˹to the masses˺, “This is only a human like you, who wants to be superior to you. Had Allah willed, He could have easily sent down angels ˹instead˺. We have never heard of this in ˹the history of˺ our forefathers

verses.arabicText: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.transliteration: In huwa illā rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbaṣū bihi ḥattā ḥīn
verses.translation: He is simply insane, so bear with him for a while.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi unṣur'nī bimā kadhabūn
verses.translation: Noah prayed, “My Lord! Help me, because they have denied ˹me˺.”

verses.arabicText: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ ۙ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَـٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-awḥaynā ilayhi ani iṣ'naʿi l-ful'ka bi-aʿyuninā wawaḥyinā fa-idhā jāa amrunā wafāra t-tanūru fa-us'luk fīhā min kullin zawjayni ith'nayni wa-ahlaka illā man sabaqa ʿalayhi l-qawlu min'hum walā tukhāṭib'nī fī alladhīna ẓalamū innahum mugh'raqūn
verses.translation: So We inspired him: “Build the Ark under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes and directions. Then when Our command comes and the oven bursts ˹with water˺, take on board a pair from every species along with your family—except those against whom the decree ˹to drown˺ has already been passed. And do not plead with Me for those who have done wrong, for they will surely be drowned.”

verses.arabicText: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-idhā is'tawayta anta wamam-maʿaka ʿalā l-ful'ki faquli l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī najjānā mina l-qawmi ẓ-ẓālimīn
verses.translation: Then when you and those with you have settled in the Ark, say, “All praise is for Allah, Who saved us from the wrongdoing people.”

verses.arabicText: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Waqul rabbi anzil'nī munzalam-mubārakaw-wa-anta khayru l-munzilīn
verses.translation: And pray, “My Lord! Allow me a blessed landing, for You are the best accommodator.”

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fī dhālika laāyātiw-wa-in kunnā lamub'talīn
verses.translation: Surely in this are lessons. And We ˹always˺ put ˹people˺ to the test

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Thumma anshanā min baʿdihim qarnan ākharīn
verses.translation: Then We raised another generation after them

verses.arabicText: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-arsalnā fīhim rasūlam-min'hum ani uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūn
verses.translation: and sent to them a messenger from among themselves, ˹declaring,˺ “Worship Allah ˹alone˺. You have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”

verses.arabicText: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waqāla l-mala-u min qawmihi alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biliqāi l-ākhirati wa-atrafnāhum fī l-ḥayati d-dun'yā mā hādhā illā basharum-mith'lukum yakulu mimmā takulūna min'hu wayashrabu mimmā tashrabūn
verses.translation: But the chiefs of his people—who disbelieved, denied the meeting ˹with Allah˺ in the Hereafter, and were spoiled by the worldly luxuries We had provided for them—said ˹to the masses˺, “This is only a human like you. He eats what you eat, and drinks what you drink

verses.arabicText: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّخَـٰسِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wala-in aṭaʿtum basharam-mith'lakum innakum idhal-lakhāsirūn
verses.translation: And if you ˹ever˺ obey a human like yourselves, then you would certainly be losers

verses.arabicText: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ayaʿidukum annakum idhā mittum wakuntum turābaw-waʿiẓāman annakum mukh'rajūn
verses.translation: Does he promise you that once you are dead and reduced to dust and bones, you will be brought forth ˹alive˺

verses.arabicText: ۞ هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Hayhāta hayhāta limā tūʿadūn
verses.translation: Impossible, simply impossible is what you are promised

verses.arabicText: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
verses.transliteration: In hiya illā ḥayātunā d-dun'yā namūtu wanaḥyā wamā naḥnu bimabʿūthīn
verses.translation: There is nothing beyond our worldly life. We die, others are born, and none will be resurrected

verses.arabicText: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: In huwa illā rajulun if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhibaw-wamā naḥnu lahu bimu'minīn
verses.translation: He is no more than a man who has fabricated a lie about Allah, and we will never believe in him.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi unṣur'nī bimā kadhabūn
verses.translation: The messenger prayed, “My Lord! Help me, because they have denied ˹me˺.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَـٰدِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla ʿammā qalīlil-layuṣ'biḥunna nādimīn
verses.translation: Allah responded, “Soon they will be truly regretful.”

verses.arabicText: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ غُثَآءً ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-akhadhathumu ṣ-ṣayḥatu bil-ḥaqi fajaʿalnāhum ghuthāan fabuʿ'dal-lil'qawmi ẓ-ẓālimīn
verses.translation: Then the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them with justice, and We reduced them to rubble. So away with the wrongdoing people

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Thumma anshanā min baʿdihim qurūnan ākharīn
verses.translation: Then We raised other generations after them

verses.arabicText: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yastakhirūn
verses.translation: No people can advance their doom, nor can they delay it

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةً رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّقَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Thumma arsalnā rusulanā tatrā kulla mā jāa ummatar-rasūluhā kadhabūhu fa-atbaʿnā baʿḍahum baʿḍaw-wajaʿalnāhum aḥādītha fabuʿ'dal-liqawmil-lā yu'minūn
verses.translation: Then We sent Our messengers in succession: whenever a messenger came to his people, they denied him. So We destroyed them, one after the other, reducing them to ˹cautionary˺ tales. So away with the people who refuse to believe

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Thumma arsalnā mūsā wa-akhāhu hārūna biāyātinā wasul'ṭānim-mubīn
verses.translation: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and compelling proof

verses.arabicText: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ
verses.transliteration: Ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi fa-is'takbarū wakānū qawman ʿālīn
verses.translation: to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a tyrannical people

verses.arabicText: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَـٰبِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Faqālū anu'minu libasharayni mith'linā waqawmuhumā lanā ʿābidūn
verses.translation: They argued, “Will we believe in two humans, like ourselves, whose people are slaves to us?”

verses.arabicText: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fakadhabūhumā fakānū mina l-muh'lakīn
verses.translation: So they rejected them both, and ˹so˺ were among those destroyed

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba laʿallahum yahtadūn
verses.translation: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so perhaps his people would be ˹rightly˺ guided

verses.arabicText: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةً وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Wajaʿalnā ib'na maryama wa-ummahu āyataw-waāwaynāhumā ilā rabwatin dhāti qarāriw-wamaʿīn
verses.translation: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and gave them refuge on high ground—a ˹suitable˺ place for rest with flowing water

verses.arabicText: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Yāayyuhā r-rusulu kulū mina ṭ-ṭayibāti wa-iʿ'malū ṣāliḥan innī bimā taʿmalūna ʿalīm
verses.translation: O messengers! Eat from what is good and lawful, and act righteously. Indeed, I fully know what you do

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-inna hādhihi ummatukum ummataw-wāḥidataw-wa-anā rabbukum fa-ittaqūn
verses.translation: Surely this religion of yours is ˹only˺ one, and I am your Lord, so fear Me ˹alone˺

verses.arabicText: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fataqaṭṭaʿū amrahum baynahum zuburan kullu ḥiz'bin bimā ladayhim fariḥūn
verses.translation: Yet the people have divided it into different sects, each rejoicing in what they have

verses.arabicText: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Fadharhum fī ghamratihim ḥattā ḥīn
verses.translation: So leave them ˹O Prophet˺ in their heedlessness for a while

verses.arabicText: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍ وَبَنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Ayaḥsabūna annamā numidduhum bihi mim-māliw-wabanīn
verses.translation: Do they think, since We provide them with wealth and children

verses.arabicText: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Nusāriʿu lahum fī l-khayrāti bal lā yashʿurūn
verses.translation: that We hasten to ˹honour˺ them ˹with˺ all kinds of good? No! They are not aware

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Inna alladhīna hum min khashyati rabbihim mush'fiqūn
verses.translation: Surely those who tremble in awe of their Lord

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna hum biāyāti rabbihim yu'minūn
verses.translation: and who believe in the revelations of their Lord

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna hum birabbihim lā yush'rikūn
verses.translation: and who associate none with their Lord

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna yu'tūna mā ātaw waqulūbuhum wajilatun annahum ilā rabbihim rājiʿūn
verses.translation: and who do whatever ˹good˺ they do with their hearts fearful, ˹knowing˺ that they will return to their Lord—

verses.arabicText: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَـٰبِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ulāika yusāriʿūna fī l-khayrāti wahum lahā sābiqūn
verses.translation: it is they who race to do good deeds, always taking the lead

verses.arabicText: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَـٰبٌ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walā nukallifu nafsan illā wus'ʿahā waladaynā kitābuy-yanṭiqu bil-ḥaqi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūn
verses.translation: We never require of any soul more than what it can afford. And with Us is a record which speaks the truth. None will be wronged

verses.arabicText: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَـٰلٌ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَـٰمِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Bal qulūbuhum fī ghamratim-min hādhā walahum aʿmālum-min dūni dhālika hum lahā ʿāmilūn
verses.translation: But the hearts of those ˹who disbelieve˺ are oblivious to ˹all of˺ this, and they have other ˹evil˺ deeds, opposite to this, in which they are engrossed

verses.arabicText: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ḥattā idhā akhadhnā mut'rafīhim bil-ʿadhābi idhā hum yajarūn
verses.translation: But as soon as We seize their elite with torment, they start to cry for help

verses.arabicText: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Lā tajarū l-yawma innakum minnā lā tunṣarūn
verses.translation: ˹They will be told,˺ “Do not cry for help today. Surely you will never be saved from Us

verses.arabicText: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَـٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qad kānat āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fakuntum ʿalā aʿqābikum tankiṣūn
verses.translation: Indeed, My revelations were recited to you, but you used to back away ˹in disgust˺

verses.arabicText: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَـٰمِرًا تَهْجُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Mus'takbirīna bihi sāmiran tahjurūn
verses.translation: boasting of the Sacred House, and babbling ˹nonsense about the Quran˺ by night.”

verses.arabicText: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Afalam yaddabbarū l-qawla am jāahum mā lam yati ābāahumu l-awalīn
verses.translation: Is it because they have never contemplated the Word ˹of Allah˺? Or ˹because˺ there has come to them something that did not come to their forefathers

verses.arabicText: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am lam yaʿrifū rasūlahum fahum lahu munkirūn
verses.translation: Or ˹because˺ they failed to recognize their Messenger, and so they denied him

verses.arabicText: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۚ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am yaqūlūna bihi jinnatun bal jāahum bil-ḥaqi wa-aktharuhum lil'ḥaqqi kārihūn
verses.translation: Or ˹because˺ they say, “He is insane?” In fact, he has come to them with the truth, but most of them are resentful of the truth

verses.arabicText: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَـٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walawi ittabaʿa l-ḥaqu ahwāahum lafasadati s-samāwātu wal-arḍu waman fīhinna bal ataynāhum bidhik'rihim fahum ʿan dhik'rihim muʿ'riḍūn
verses.translation: Had the truth followed their desires, the heavens, the earth, and all those in them would have certainly been corrupted. In fact, We have brought them ˹the means to˺ their glory, but they turn away from it

verses.arabicText: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Am tasaluhum kharjan fakharāju rabbika khayruw-wahuwa khayru r-rāziqīn
verses.translation: Or ˹is it because˺ you ˹O Prophet˺ are asking them for tribute? But the reward of your Lord is best, for He is the Best Provider

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa-innaka latadʿūhum ilā ṣirāṭim-mus'taqīm
verses.translation: And surely you are calling them to the Straight Path

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَـٰكِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati ʿani ṣ-ṣirāṭi lanākibūn
verses.translation: but those who disbelieve in the Hereafter are certainly deviating from that Path

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَـٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَـٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walaw raḥim'nāhum wakashafnā mā bihim min ḍurril-lalajjū fī ṭugh'yānihim yaʿmahūn
verses.translation: ˹Even˺ if We had mercy on them and removed their affliction, they would still persist in their transgression, wandering blindly

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad akhadhnāhum bil-ʿadhābi famā is'takānū lirabbihim wamā yataḍarraʿūn
verses.translation: And We have already seized them with torment, but they never humbled themselves to their Lord, nor did they ˹submissively˺ appeal ˹to Him˺

verses.arabicText: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ḥattā idhā fataḥnā ʿalayhim bāban dhā ʿadhābin shadīdin idhā hum fīhi mub'lisūn
verses.translation: But as soon as We open for them a gate of severe punishment, they will be utterly desperate

verses.arabicText: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wahuwa alladhī ansha-a lakumu s-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlam-mā tashkurūn
verses.translation: He is the One Who created for you hearing, sight, and intellect. ˹Yet˺ you hardly give any thanks

verses.arabicText: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wahuwa alladhī dhara-akum fī l-arḍi wa-ilayhi tuḥ'sharūn
verses.translation: And He is the One Who has dispersed you ˹all˺ over the earth, and to Him you will ˹all˺ be gathered

verses.arabicText: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلَـٰفُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wahuwa alladhī yuḥ'yī wayumītu walahu ikh'tilāfu al-layli wal-nahāri afalā taʿqilūn
verses.translation: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death, and to Him belongs the alternation of the day and night. Will you not then understand

verses.arabicText: بَلْ قَالُوا۟ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Bal qālū mith'la mā qāla l-awalūn
verses.translation: But they ˹just˺ say what their predecessors said

verses.arabicText: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turābaw-waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūn
verses.translation: They said, “Once we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected

verses.arabicText: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَـٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Laqad wuʿid'nā naḥnu waābāunā hādhā min qablu in hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīn
verses.translation: We have already been promised this, as well as our forefathers earlier. This is nothing but ancient fables!”

verses.arabicText: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qul limani l-arḍu waman fīhā in kuntum taʿlamūn
verses.translation: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “To whom belong the earth and all those on it, if you ˹really˺ know?”

verses.arabicText: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Sayaqūlūna lillahi qul afalā tadhakkarūn
verses.translation: They will reply, “To Allah!” Say, “Why are you not then mindful?”

verses.arabicText: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Qul mar-rabbu s-samāwāti s-sabʿi warabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīm
verses.translation: ˹And˺ ask ˹them˺, “Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Mighty Throne?”

verses.arabicText: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Sayaqūlūna lillahi qul afalā tattaqūn
verses.translation: They will reply, “Allah.” Say, “Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”

verses.arabicText: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qul man biyadihi malakūtu kulli shayiw-wahuwa yujīru walā yujāru ʿalayhi in kuntum taʿlamūn
verses.translation: Ask ˹them also,˺ “In Whose Hands is the authority over all things, protecting ˹all˺ while none can protect against Him, if you ˹really˺ know?”

verses.arabicText: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Sayaqūlūna lillahi qul fa-annā tus'ḥarūn
verses.translation: They will reply, “Allah.” Say, “How are you then so deluded?”

verses.arabicText: بَلْ أَتَيْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Bal ataynāhum bil-ḥaqi wa-innahum lakādhibūn
verses.translation: In fact, We have brought them the truth, and they are certainly liars

verses.arabicText: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ ۚ إِذًا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَـٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.transliteration: Mā ittakhadha l-lahu miw-waladiw-wamā kāna maʿahu min ilāhin idhal-ladhahaba kullu ilāhin bimā khalaqa walaʿalā baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yaṣifūn
verses.translation: Allah has never had ˹any˺ offspring, nor is there any god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have taken away what he created, and they would have tried to dominate one another. Glorified is Allah above what they claim

verses.arabicText: عَـٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ فَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.transliteration: ʿālimi l-ghaybi wal-shahādati fataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūn
verses.translation: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the seen and unseen. Exalted is He above what they associate ˹with Him˺

verses.arabicText: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qul rabbi immā turiyannī mā yūʿadūn
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord! Should You show me what they are threatened with

verses.arabicText: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Rabbi falā tajʿalnī fī l-qawmi ẓ-ẓālimīn
verses.translation: then, my Lord, do not count me among the wrongdoing people.”

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-innā ʿalā an-nuriyaka mā naʿiduhum laqādirūn
verses.translation: We are indeed able to show you what We have threatened them with

verses.arabicText: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
verses.transliteration: Id'faʿ bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu s-sayi-ata naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaṣifūn
verses.translation: Respond to evil with what is best. We know well what they claim

verses.arabicText: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ
verses.transliteration: Waqul rabbi aʿūdhu bika min hamazāti sh-shayāṭīn
verses.translation: And say, “My Lord! I seek refuge in You from the temptations of the devils

verses.arabicText: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-aʿūdhu bika rabbi ay-yaḥḍurūn
verses.translation: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, that they ˹even˺ come near me.”

verses.arabicText: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ
verses.transliteration: Ḥattā idhā jāa aḥadahumu l-mawtu qāla rabbi ir'jiʿūn
verses.translation: When death approaches any of them, they cry, “My Lord! Let me go back

verses.arabicText: لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَـٰلِحًا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّآ ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.transliteration: Laʿallī aʿmalu ṣāliḥan fīmā taraktu kallā innahā kalimatun huwa qāiluhā wamiw-warāihim barzakhun ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūn
verses.translation: so I may do good in what I left behind.” Never! It is only a ˹useless˺ appeal they make. And there is a barrier behind them until the Day they are resurrected

verses.arabicText: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-idhā nufikha fī ṣ-ṣūri falā ansāba baynahum yawma-idhiw-walā yatasāalūn
verses.translation: Then, when the Trumpet will be blown, there will be no kinship between them on that Day, nor will they ˹even care to˺ ask about one another

verses.arabicText: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.transliteration: Faman thaqulat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūn
verses.translation: As for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺, it is they who will be successful

verses.arabicText: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waman khaffat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika alladhīna khasirū anfusahum fī jahannama khālidūn
verses.translation: But those whose scale is light, they will have doomed themselves, staying in Hell forever

verses.arabicText: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَـٰلِحُونَ
verses.transliteration: Talfaḥu wujūhahumu n-nāru wahum fīhā kāliḥūn
verses.translation: The Fire will burn their faces, leaving them deformed

verses.arabicText: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Alam takun āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fakuntum bihā tukadhibūn
verses.translation: ˹It will be said,˺ “Were My revelations not recited to you, but you used to deny them?”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَآلِّينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū rabbanā ghalabat ʿalaynā shiq'watunā wakunnā qawman ḍāllīn
verses.translation: They will cry, “Our Lord! Our ill-fate took hold of us, so we became a misguided people

verses.arabicText: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَـٰلِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Rabbanā akhrij'nā min'hā fa-in ʿud'nā fa-innā ẓālimūn
verses.translation: Our Lord! Take us out of this ˹Fire˺. Then if we ever return ˹to denial˺, we will truly be wrongdoers.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ ٱخْسَـُٔوا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
verses.transliteration: Qāla ikh'saū fīhā walā tukallimūn
verses.translation: Allah will respond, “Be despised in there! Do not ˹ever˺ plead with Me ˹again˺

verses.arabicText: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Innahu kāna farīqum-min ʿibādī yaqūlūna rabbanā āmannā fa-igh'fir lanā wa-ir'ḥamnā wa-anta khayru r-rāḥimīn
verses.translation: Indeed, there was a group of My servants who used to pray, ‘Our Lord! We have believed, so forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the best of those who show mercy,’

verses.arabicText: فَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-ittakhadhtumūhum sikh'riyyan ḥattā ansawkum dhik'rī wakuntum min'hum taḍḥakūn
verses.translation: but you were ˹so busy˺ making fun of them that it made you forget My remembrance. And you used to laugh at them

verses.arabicText: إِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
verses.transliteration: Innī jazaytuhumu l-yawma bimā ṣabarū annahum humu l-fāizūn
verses.translation: Today I have indeed rewarded them for their perseverance: they are certainly the triumphant.”

verses.arabicText: قَـٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla kam labith'tum fī l-arḍi ʿadada sinīn
verses.translation: He will ask ˹them˺, “How many years did you remain on earth?”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْعَآدِّينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū labith'nā yawman aw baʿḍa yawmin fasali l-ʿādīn
verses.translation: They will reply, “We remained ˹only˺ a day or part of a day. But ask those who kept count.”

verses.arabicText: قَـٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla il-labith'tum illā qalīlal-law annakum kuntum taʿlamūn
verses.translation: He will say, “You only remained for a little while, if only you knew

verses.arabicText: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Afaḥasib'tum annamā khalaqnākum ʿabathaw-wa-annakum ilaynā lā tur'jaʿūn
verses.translation: Did you then think that We had created you without purpose, and that you would never be returned to Us?”

verses.arabicText: فَتَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Fataʿālā l-lahu l-maliku l-ḥaqu lā ilāha illā huwa rabbu l-ʿarshi l-karīm
verses.translation: Exalted is Allah, the True King! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, the Lord of the Honourable Throne

verses.arabicText: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَـٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wamay-yadʿu maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara lā bur'hāna lahu bihi fa-innamā ḥisābuhu ʿinda rabbihi innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-kāfirūn
verses.translation: Whoever invokes, besides Allah, another god—for which they can have no proof—they will surely find their penalty with their Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will never succeed

verses.arabicText: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Waqul rabbi igh'fir wa-ir'ḥam wa-anta khayru r-rāḥimīn
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of those who show mercy.”
